about: DIFFERENTIAL-passing calculators that did NOT prove full live parity. Not migrated. Each needs the fix described before it can join engine-migrated.json.

reasons.REGISTRY_INCOMPLETE: Live calculator has an input (usually a unit/mode selector or a physical constant exposed as an input) that the registry formula does not have. The registry only matches the live page for the default setting. Fix: add the input to the registry entry, then re-prove.
reasons.DOMAIN_RULES_NEEDED: Values agree everywhere both compute, but the live renderer rejects a zero (or non-positive) input that the registry expression evaluates. The engine must not call VALID what the product calls invalid. Fix: add the live guard to the registry expression using the existing registry pattern ([..].every(n=>n>0) ? expr : NaN), then re-prove.
reasons.REGISTRY_STUB: Registry formula is a simplified stand-in that agrees with the live algorithm only at default inputs.
reasons.LIVE_DEFECT: Live renderer shows a number for physically invalid input, or has an engineering defect found during parity. Needs an owner-visible fix in the live calculator before migration.
reasons.UNIT_DIVERGENCE: Registry and live display the same quantity in different units.
reasons.MODE_DEPENDENT: Calculator has solve-for modes; some registry inputs are not rendered in the default mode, so they cannot be bound. Needs per-mode registry entries.

optimal_shift.detail: Registry: shift RPM = peak-HP RPM (3 inputs). Live: searches the torque curve for the shift point that maximises wheel torque (7 inputs). Also shows a shift RPM when peak-HP RPM is 0.

ev_motor_power.detail: Registry output "Motor Power (kW)" = 340.8 kW; live displays the same power as 457 HP. Per the canonical-units decision (native US/Imperial), the registry output should be HP; that is a formula change and needs re-verification.

fuse_sizing.detail: Live has a Load Type selector (continuous/non-continuous) and a Next Standard Size output; registry models only the continuous 1.25x case.

hp_quarter_mile.detail: Trap-speed vs ET mode; the ET input is not rendered in the default (trap) mode.

pinion_angle_change.detail: Live displays 0° (with a warning line) when the axle-to-pivot distance is 0, where the angle is undefined. Unknown/invalid must not display as zero. Engine returns atan(x/0)=90°, also invalid: needs a >0 domain rule in the registry.

time_speed_dist.detail: Solve-for distance/time/speed modes; the distance input is hidden in the default mode.

bolt_pattern.detail: Registry hard-codes 5 lugs (ignores the lug-count input). Live mixes measurement conventions (adjacent-stud geometry for 4/5/8 lugs, PCD = measurement for 6) and its fallback branch for other lug counts returns meas/(2 sin(π/n)), a RADIUS, labelled as bolt-circle DIAMETER (2x error). Needs a sourced convention decision.

diesel_airflow.detail: Live rejects: da_disp=0, da_rpm=0, da_ve=0, da_air=0

tire_size_comparison.detail: Live rejects: tsc_ow=0, tsc_oa=0, tsc_od=0, tsc_nw=0, tsc_na=0, tsc_nd=0

throttle_body.detail: Live rejects: tb_cid=0, tb_rpm=0, tb_ve=0, tb_vel=0

diesel_injector_flow.detail: Not all registry inputs are rendered with defaults; needs per-mode review.
